device.description: octal 8-bit voltage-output DAC with TMS320/SPI serial interface (FS frame sync), LDAC, preset and DOUT daisy-chain output
device.note: tlv5608.pdf (SLAS268G) p.1 (DW/PW pinout, description), p.2 (terminal functions), p.3 (recommended operating conditions: AVDD/DVDD 2.7-3.3 V and 4.5-5.5 V, fCLK 30 MHz), p.5 (timing requirements), p.6 (Figure 1 serial interface timing, Figure 2 LDAC), p.11 (power-on reset, serial interface, daisy chain), p.12 (uC/DSP modes, data format, register map), p.13 (two-channel registers, preset, CTRL0, CTRL1)

registers.name: INA
registers.note: DAC A holding register (A3-A0 = 0, register map p.12); power-on zero (p.11)

registers.name: INB
registers.note: DAC B holding register (A3-A0 = 1, register map p.12); power-on zero (p.11)

registers.name: INC
registers.note: DAC C holding register (A3-A0 = 2, register map p.12); power-on zero (p.11)

registers.name: IND
registers.note: DAC D holding register (A3-A0 = 3, register map p.12); power-on zero (p.11)

registers.name: INE
registers.note: DAC E holding register (A3-A0 = 4, register map p.12); power-on zero (p.11)

registers.name: INF
registers.note: DAC F holding register (A3-A0 = 5, register map p.12); power-on zero (p.11)

registers.name: ING
registers.note: DAC G holding register (A3-A0 = 6, register map p.12); power-on zero (p.11)

registers.name: INH
registers.note: DAC H holding register (A3-A0 = 7, register map p.12); power-on zero (p.11)

registers.name: DACA
registers.note: DAC A latch; loaded from the holding register while LDAC is low (p.11)

registers.name: DACB
registers.note: DAC B latch; loaded from the holding register while LDAC is low (p.11)

registers.name: DACC
registers.note: DAC C latch; loaded from the holding register while LDAC is low (p.11)

registers.name: DACD
registers.note: DAC D latch; loaded from the holding register while LDAC is low (p.11)

registers.name: DACE
registers.note: DAC E latch; loaded from the holding register while LDAC is low (p.11)

registers.name: DACF
registers.note: DAC F latch; loaded from the holding register while LDAC is low (p.11)

registers.name: DACG
registers.note: DAC G latch; loaded from the holding register while LDAC is low (p.11)

registers.name: DACH
registers.note: DAC H latch; loaded from the holding register while LDAC is low (p.11)

registers.name: CTRL0
registers.note: A3-A0 = 1000: PD full power down, DO DOUT enable, IM input mode (0 straight, 1 twos complement); other bits reserved (p.13); power-on zero (p.11)

registers.name: CTRL1
registers.note: A3-A0 = 1001: PXY power down DAC pair XY, SXY fast settling of pair XY (p.13); power-on zero (p.11)

registers.name: PRESET
registers.note: A3-A0 = 1010: preset value for PRE (p.13); cleared by POR (p.11)

commands.name: Write DAC
commands.note: A3-A0 0-7 = DAC A-H holding register; 12-15 = two-channel registers DAC A and B ... G and H (register map p.12); TLV5629 decodes D11-D4 (p.13)

protocol.note: uC mode (MODE high): FS low frames the 16-bit word, data sampled MSB first on SCLK falling edges (SCLK low at FS falling, Figure 1); FS high before the 16th falling edge cancels the transfer; the holding register is written after FS rises (p.12)

ldac.note: DAC outputs updated only while LDAC is low; asynchronous (p.2, p.11)

pages: p.1 (DW/PW pinout, description), p.2 (terminal functions), p.3 (recommended operating conditions: AVDD/DVDD 2.7-3.3 V and 4.5-5.5 V, fCLK 30 MHz), p.5 (timing requirements), p.6 (Figure 1 serial interface timing, Figure 2 LDAC), p.11 (power-on reset, serial interface, daisy chain), p.12 (uC/DSP modes, data format, register map), p.13 (two-channel registers, preset, CTRL0, CTRL1)
notModeled: analog: voltage outputs, reference input REF, settling speed (CTRL1 SXY) and pair/full power down effects (CTRL1 PXY, CTRL0 PD), twos-complement input mode (CTRL0.IM: the code is stored as written)
DSP mode (MODE open or low: 16 bits clocked after a short FS low pulse, extra SCLK falling edge before FS) is not modeled; uC mode (MODE high) is
two-channel registers (A3-A0 = 1100-1111) write the value to one DAC of the pair and its complement to the other (p.13); the model writes the same value to both
PRE pin: driving PRE low with LDAC asserted loads the PRESET register value into the DAC outputs (p.13); not modeled (PRE is an unused input)
DOUT daisy-chain output (DIN delayed 16 SCLK cycles while CTRL0.DO = 1, p.11, p.13) is not modeled: DOUT is never driven
variants: tlv5608.pdf covers TLV5610 (12-bit), TLV5608 (10-bit, decodes D11-D2) and TLV5629 (8-bit, decodes D11-D4): same pinout and register map; one spec file each.
